name: Bitch Battle Royale
original_name: ビッチバトルロワイヤル
source:
The Enkou JK leader, horny black gyaru Leia, and the innocent white gyaru Ruka, who enjoys her sugar baby life solo, are like cats and dogs. Their turf war starts when they compete for sugar daddies.
There are rules for sluts and rules for sugar daddies. They pick their targets based on the theme, like old businessmen, timid boys, and virgin otakus, and see who can rake in more dough in an "Enkou showdown." Only the winner gets the freedom of living that sweet sugar baby life!
All for pride, freedom, and the pursuit of money and pleasure - the ultimate JK compensated dating battle begins right here!
